QF.id: SIA Logic Model for Social Programs_45

question.text: Per Ch 4.4, the Logical Framework Matrix ensures which three qualities in project design and execution?

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Ch 4.4, the Logical Framework Matrix ensures alignment, coherence, and clarity in project design and execution. These qualities combine to make the project plan coherent end-to-end (from inputs through to impact) and transparent to stakeholders. The Trap: B is a financial P&L triad, irrelevant here. C, D are antithetical to good project management discipline and transparency. Cross-Exam Context: LFM quality attributes are tested in XXIII Ch 4/5 and parallel audit-trail quality attributes in statutory audit. Assessor's Pro-Tip: When reviewing an LFM, rate it on alignment (do the rows logically link?), coherence (do indicators across rows tell a consistent story?) and clarity (can a non-specialist read it?). Failing any one suggests redesign.
